message:
chore(desktop): prune stale staged audio in the dev engine bridge (#110)

Staged files under %TEMP%/hornscribe-dev accumulated forever — every
browser-dev transcription left its bytes behind. /stage now drops
staged-* files older than 24h before writing the new one (best-effort,
never fails a stage).
